self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Frost Burial: Normal/Charged Attack hits have a 100% chance (CD 10s) to drop an Everfrost Icicle dealing AoE DMG equal to 140% of ATK (360% instead against Cryo-affected opponents, not modeled here — using the baseline 140% value); modeled as a supplementary hit — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses.

en.flavor: An ancient greatsword that was stored between frescoes. Forged from Starsilver, it has the power to cleave through ice and snow.

refinements.1: Hitting an opponent with Normal and Charged Attacks has a <r>60%</r> chance of forming and dropping an Everfrost Icicle above them, dealing AoE DMG equal to <r>80%</r> of ATK. Opponents affected by Cryo are instead dealt DMG equal to <r>200%</r> of ATK. Can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.2: Hitting an opponent with Normal and Charged Attacks has a <r>70%</r> chance of forming and dropping an Everfrost Icicle above them, dealing AoE DMG equal to <r>95%</r> of ATK. Opponents affected by Cryo are instead dealt DMG equal to <r>240%</r> of ATK. Can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.3: Hitting an opponent with Normal and Charged Attacks has an <r>80%</r> chance of forming and dropping an Everfrost Icicle above them, dealing AoE DMG equal to <r>110%</r> of ATK. Opponents affected by Cryo are instead dealt DMG equal to <r>280%</r> of ATK. Can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.4: Hitting an opponent with Normal and Charged Attacks has a <r>90%</r> chance of forming and dropping an Everfrost Icicle above them, dealing AoE DMG equal to <r>125%</r> of ATK. Opponents affected by Cryo are instead dealt DMG equal to <r>320%</r> of ATK. Can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.5: Hitting an opponent with Normal and Charged Attacks has a <r>100%</r> chance of forming and dropping an Everfrost Icicle above them, dealing AoE DMG equal to <r>140%</r> of ATK. Opponents affected by Cryo are instead dealt DMG equal to <r>360%</r> of ATK. Can only occur once every 10s.

fr.flavor: Un espadon antique autrefois dissimulé entre des fresques. Forgée en argétoile, cette arme a le pouvoir de fendre la neige et la glace.

refinements.1: Les attaques normales et chargées ont <r>60 %</r> de chances lorsqu'elles touchent de générer une stalactite de glace qui inflige des DGT de zone équivalant à <r>80 %</r> de l'ATQ. Si l'ennemi est affecté par l'élément Cryo, la stalactite inflige alors <r>200 %</r> de l'ATQ. Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 10 s.
